Here are the 1-bed flats in Hackney and Islington under £2,600/month, with commute times to Liverpool Street. Seven listings came back, priced £1,800–£2,500 (median around £2,250).

| # | Address | Area | Rent/month | Commute to Liverpool Street |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | King Square, EC1V | Islington | £1,800 | ~18 min (estimated, unverified) |
| 2 | Jacob House, E8 | Hackney | £1,950 | 28 min (routed) |
| 3 | Arbutus Street, Haggerston, E8 | Hackney | £2,200 | ~22 min (estimated, unverified) |
| 4 | Eden Grove, N7 | Islington | £2,250 | ~30 min (estimated, unverified) |
| 5 | 22-24 Powell Road, E5 | Hackney | £2,300 | ~31 min (estimated, unverified) |
| 6 | St. Clements Street, N7 | Islington | £2,500 | ~27 min (estimated, unverified) |
| 7 | Queensbridge Road, E2 | Hackney | £2,500 | 14 min (routed) |

A note on the commute figures: only Jacob House (28 min) and Queensbridge Road (14 min) have measured journey times from the TfL Journey Planner. The others are straight-line estimates and should be treated as rough ranges, not confirmed journey times.

Two over-budget alternatives also appeared, in case you want to stretch: Featherstone Street, Old Street, EC1Y at £2,701 (about 14 min estimated) and Northwold Road, E5 at £2,800 (28 min routed).

Best value picks: King Square at £1,800 is the cheapest and closest to the City, and Queensbridge Road at £2,500 has the fastest measured commute at 14 minutes.

Want me to pull full details on any of these, or check safety and nearby amenities for a particular one?
